lesson: A frozen f32-scale FP8 task can reward switching to production packed UE8M0 without proving a new production win. Always repeat the candidate against the exact packed ABI and through eager plus CUDA-graph integration; keep stock fallback when those modes disagree or end-to-end validation is unavailable.
